findings.title: Optimized audit pagination crashes on datetime fields
findings.description: The audit endpoint orders by `datetime`, but this paginator applies `math.ceil`/`math.floor` directly to that value. Any nonempty optimized response raises `TypeError`, reproduced using the actual method. Preserve `DateTimePaginator`’s timestamp conversion in both directions.

findings.title: Unconditional membership access breaks token requests
findings.description: Organization-scoped API authentication can pass `OrganizationAuditPermission` without an organization member. Dereferencing `organization_context.member.has_global_access` then raises `AttributeError`, even when optimized pagination was not requested. Guard the optional member and evaluate advanced eligibility only when needed.

findings.title: Redis data-type change cannot read existing buffers
findings.description: Existing `span-buf:s:*` keys contain Redis sets, but the same keys now receive `ZADD` and are read with `ZSCAN`. Buffered data surviving deployment causes `WRONGTYPE` failures in ingestion or flushing. Introduce a compatible migration or versioned keys with an old-buffer drain strategy.

findings.title: Negative slicing is not supported by Django querysets
findings.description:
The advanced branch passes negative offsets directly to a Django queryset, which rejects negative indexing rather than handling boundaries automatically. Reject invalid offsets with `BadPaginationError`, or implement reverse traversal using supported cursor queries.

Full tests were not run: Django is unavailable in the environment.

structured_findings.summary: Optimized audit pagination crashes on datetime fields
